purpose: Finite exploratory replication requested by user after existing outcomes were seen
source: Unmodified published 2017 source-cohort lists, sampled before downloads, no missing-name replacements
primary_policy: Equal top 10, fixed before new results
secondary_policy: Existing prior-validation-only choice among K5/K10/K20 and five policies
identity_rule: Reject known reused symbols and old-cohort symbols whose downloaded histories begin after 2018; retain as missing, no replacement
stop_rule: Report all three draws, all seeds and all specified models without adaptive additions
limitations: Historical source lists themselves have survivorship bias
Overlapping draws on the same dates are dependent
Three draws estimate sensitivity, not statistical confirmation
No NYSX ETF history exists in 2022-2025
